<h1 style="text-align: center;">Activities at the<br />
campsite</h1>
<p></div></div><div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 32px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: center;">At Drejby Strand Camping, you&#8217;ll find plenty of activities for the whole family.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Feel the rush of high-speed action and find tranquility in quiet family moments. Our activity program offers a wide range of activities – from football school, pool parties, and creative workshops to classic campfire coziness with traditional twist bread. Here, there are experiences for both daredevils and those who prefer to relax. Dive into our many activities and find your next adventure!</p>
<h4 style="text-align: center;">Check the weekly schedule on site!</h4>

		</div>
	</div>

<h3>Soccer School (Weeks 28-32)</h3>
<p></div></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  text-padding" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: center;">The football school will be held on Friday and Saturday during the Ascension Day holiday, and on Saturday and Sunday at Pentecost 2026.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Every Monday, Wednesday and Friday during the high season, there are ball games and a football school for all children aged 7-14.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">A former youth coach for SV Werder Bremen and DSC Arminia Bielefeld is in charge of the activities.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Come and join.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div><div data-min-height="450" class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid switch-order-mobile full-width-wrap dt-default" style="padding-left: 0px;padding-right: 0px;margin-top: 0px;margin-bottom: 0px"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6 vc_col-has-fill"><div class="vc_column-inner vc_custom_1722927682755"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div id="ultimate-heading-30836acd56668c9f0" class="uvc-heading ult-adjust-bottom-margin ultimate-heading-30836acd56668c9f0 uvc-3385  uvc-heading-default-font-sizes" data-hspacer="no_spacer"  data-halign="center" style="text-align:center"><div class="uvc-heading-spacer no_spacer" style="top"></div><div class="uvc-sub-heading ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='.uvc-heading.ultimate-heading-30836acd56668c9f0 .uvc-sub-heading '  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}'  style="font-weight:normal;"></p>
<h3>Aqua Fitness (Week 30 &#8211; 32)</h3>
<p></div></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  text-padding" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: center;">For the early birds, there is Aqua Fitness every day  from 8:30 to 9:30</p>

		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6 vc_col-has-fill"><div class="vc_column-inner vc_custom_1722928352748"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 450px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div></div></div></div></div><div data-min-height="450" class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid switch-order-mobile, columns-2 full-width-wrap dt-default" style="padding-left: 0px;padding-right: 0px;margin-top: 0px;margin-bottom: 0px"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6 vc_col-has-fill"><div class="vc_column-inner vc_custom_1613748174753"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 450px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6 vc_col-has-fill"><div class="vc_column-inner vc_custom_1722927725369"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div id="ultimate-heading-49536acd56668cc40" class="uvc-heading ult-adjust-bottom-margin ultimate-heading-49536acd56668cc40 uvc-7433  uvc-heading-default-font-sizes" data-hspacer="no_spacer"  data-halign="center" style="text-align:center"><div class="uvc-heading-spacer no_spacer" style="top"></div><div class="uvc-sub-heading ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='.uvc-heading.ultimate-heading-49536acd56668cc40 .uvc-sub-heading '  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}'  style="font-weight:normal;"></p>

<p></div></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  text-padding" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: center;">Discover the house and the ship with the younger children at the<br />
playground next to Play Land. You can safely let the young ones play<br />
at the playground.</p>

<p></div></div>

	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >

<h3>Drejby pool med Surfing Hill</h3>
<p></div></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  text-padding" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: center;">On the campsite, you&#8217;ll find a pool for all ages, with plenty of space for both swimming and playing.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Take a ride down our Surfing Hill slide – or let the water clown splash you with water. During the high season, children can join our fun and festive pool party.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">The pool is exclusively for guests staying at the campsite.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">The pool is heated to 24°C.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Open from the end of May to the end of August.</p>

<div id="ultimate-heading-85636acd56669112a" class="uvc-heading ult-adjust-bottom-margin ultimate-heading-85636acd56669112a uvc-1651  uvc-heading-default-font-sizes" data-hspacer="no_spacer"  data-halign="center" style="text-align:center"><div class="uvc-heading-spacer no_spacer" style="top"></div><div class="uvc-main-heading ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='.uvc-heading.ultimate-heading-85636acd56669112a h2'  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}' ><h2 style="--font-weight:theme;margin-top:30px;">Camping</h2></div></div><div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 32px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: center;">Drejby Strand Camping has 450 pitches for<br />
tent, caravans and campers.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<style></style><div class="btn-align-center"><a href="https://www.drejby.com/camping-pitches/" class="default-btn-shortcode dt-btn dt-btn-s link-hover-off  vc_custom_1705586587305" id="default-btn-05307f787186d722672cffdbb66e8dd7"><span>Read about camping</span></a></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div  class="wpb_single_image wpb_content_element vc_align_center">
		
		<figure class="wpb_wrapper vc_figure">
			<div class="vc_single_image-wrapper   vc_box_border_grey"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="800" height="480" src="https://www.drejby.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/hytte.jpg" class="vc_single_image-img attachment-full" alt="ferienhütten" title="hytte"  data-dt-location="https://www.drejby.dk/hytte-5/" /></div>
		</figure>
	</div>
<div id="ultimate-heading-71606acd566692f42" class="uvc-heading ult-adjust-bottom-margin ultimate-heading-71606acd566692f42 uvc-5247  uvc-heading-default-font-sizes" data-hspacer="no_spacer"  data-halign="center" style="text-align:center"><div class="uvc-heading-spacer no_spacer" style="top"></div><div class="uvc-main-heading ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='.uvc-heading.ultimate-heading-71606acd566692f42 h2'  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}' ><h2 style="--font-weight:theme;margin-top:30px;">Cabins</h2></div></div><div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 32px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: center;">Our cabins are for four persons, and<br />
many with own toilet, extra sink and television.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<style></style><div class="btn-align-center"><a href="https://www.drejby.com/holiday-cabins/" class="default-btn-shortcode dt-btn dt-btn-s link-hover-off  vc_custom_1618396984179" id="default-btn-49432de07eedb478797c97edd24f66a7" title="Campinghytter"><span>Read about cabins</span></a></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div  class="wpb_single_image wpb_content_element vc_align_center">
		
		<figure class="wpb_wrapper vc_figure">
			<div class="vc_single_image-wrapper   vc_box_border_grey"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="800" height="480" src="https://www.drejby.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/ferielejlighed.jpg" class="vc_single_image-img attachment-full" alt="Ferielejlighed" title="ferielejlighed"  data-dt-location="https://www.drejby.dk/ferielejlighed-2-2/" /></div>
		</figure>
	</div>
<div id="ultimate-heading-41216acd566693b7f" class="uvc-heading ult-adjust-bottom-margin ultimate-heading-41216acd566693b7f uvc-8027  uvc-heading-default-font-sizes" data-hspacer="no_spacer"  data-halign="center" style="text-align:center"><div class="uvc-heading-spacer no_spacer" style="top"></div><div class="uvc-main-heading ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='.uvc-heading.ultimate-heading-41216acd566693b7f h2'  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}' ><h2 style="--font-weight:theme;margin-top:30px;">Apartments</h2></div></div><div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 32px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: center;">An apartment in South Jutland is<br />
a good alternative for a cottage.</p>
